name: Mechanical Butterfly Symphony
description: A field of mechanical butterflies, their wings beating in perfect harmony, creating a soft symphony of metallic tones as they flutter among flower‑like sculptures.
prompt: Vast field of mechanical butterflies with metallic wings, intricate gears visible, surrounding flower sculptures that glow, gentle breezes cause synchronized movement, melodic tones visualized as light, hyperrealistic, no text, mesmerizing spectacle.
caption: Experience a garden where butterflies are crafted from metal yet sing—beauty forged in steel and song.
